Class StyleWatch

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.client.StyleWatch
final class StyleWatch extends Object
Counts how the opponent of a /swordai fight fights, from what this game can see of it, into that player's PersonStyle: where it keeps its distance, whether it answers the fighter's hits on its way down, whether it comes after a fighter that backs off with a hit from the air, how far a hit sends it, whether it jumps with the hits it takes. Saved when the fight stops. Nothing of it reaches the network in the fight; training makes a scripted opponent of it.
